activity_summary: After Errors you went up to Holywell for the cake. The bean fell to Nick, who has played queens since he was eleven and was king for the first time. He set Kemp a paternoster, Heminges no Item till morning, and Sam the last slice. Kemp lasted about half the prayer, named the Admiral's men at Greenwich, and did not mind them. James said twenty-one years, and two to run. Cuthbert moved the jug. Heminges gave eleven pound eight shillings to the sharers' side, without a drum or a trumpet, then said Item and was fined a slice for Sam. Sam did not speak. Mistress Burbage did not speak.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the yard had been full, and that nobody minds Greenwich, and left the money on the sharers' side.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Said twenty-one years, and two to run, and stopped there.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Hailed the king and kept his mother out of the speeches.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: Moved the jug and told them to leave the lease where it was.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Took the bean gravely, issued the three decrees, and fined Heminges a slice for Sam.

entities.name: Will Kemp

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Gave the eleven pound eight, said Item, and paid the slice.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Present. Silent. Took the last slice and the fine.

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: Master Kemp shall keep silence the length of a paternoster.

quotes.speaker: james_burbage
quotes.text: Twenty-one years, and two to run.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: The Admiral's men are at Greenwich again tonight.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: The holiday boxes cleared eleven pound eight shillings, to the sharers' side, without a drum or a trumpet.
